remarks:
Bring your vision and make this charming diamond in the rough shine! Situated on a spacious .50-acre lot, this character-filled home offers an affordable opportunity for buyers looking to build equity and create a space that truly feels like their own. With solid bones, unique architectural details, hardwood floors throughout much of the home, and plenty of potential, a little cosmetic updating could transform this property into something truly special.

The convenient first-floor living layout features two bedrooms, a full bathroom with a walk-in shower, and laundry, making everyday living easy and accessible. The large galley-style kitchen offers plenty of room to work with and is ready for your personal touches. The former attached garage has been converted into additional bonus living space and also includes laundry hookups, providing flexibility for a family room, hobby area, home office, mudroom, or whatever best fits your needs. Upstairs, you'll find a charming loft-style bedroom plus an additional bonus room, offering even more possibilities for guests, an office, playroom, dressing room, or extra storage.

Throughout the home, you'll discover lots of character and unique features, including beautiful hardwood flooring just waiting to be polished and brought back to its original warmth and beauty. Two covered porch areas provide inviting spots to relax, enjoy your morning coffee, or unwind at the end of the day.

Outside, the generous half-acre lot opens the door to so many possibilities! Gardening, entertaining, a future pool, play areas, pets, outdoor gatherings, or simply creating your own private backyard retreat. Several important improvements have already been completed, including a new 200-amp electrical system, newer hot water tank, and fully insulated upstairs crawl spaces.

This affordable fixer-upper is packed with potential. Bring your ideas, add your personal style, polish those hardwood floors, and turn this solid home into the beautiful dream home you know it can be!
